title: The mechanical gates a build wave passes through
description: tdd-guard turns TDD into a state machine two different agents pass through: one seals the tests, the other implements against them, and the Stop hook releases a pull request only on fresh evidence.

nodes.label: oracle
nodes.sub: writes the acceptance tests, then runs RED

nodes.label: integrator (baseline)
nodes.sub: behaviour-preserving work: proves the suite green

nodes.label: tdd-guard seal
nodes.sub: kind: red, or kind: baseline for refactor work

nodes.label: builder implements
nodes.sub: a different agent from the one that wrote the tests

nodes.label: tdd-guard diff-review record
nodes.sub: findings bound to the current diff

nodes.label: Stop hook
nodes.sub: is every piece of evidence fresh?

nodes.label: PR allowed
nodes.sub: the gate decides the merge, never a handoff
